issues.t: Valve cover gasket leaks oil onto the alternator
issues.sym: Oil on the engine and dripping under the van, a burning-oil smell, and sometimes electrical trouble when oil reaches the alternator.
issues.why: The V6 valve cover gaskets harden and leak. On this van the leaking oil runs down onto the alternator, which sits below. It is the most-reported problem for the Entourage.
issues.next: Have the leak fixed soon, before oil ruins the alternator or drips on the hot exhaust. Ask the shop to replace the spark plug tube seals at the same time.

issues.t: Alternator fails and the van loses power
issues.sym: Battery warning light, dimming lights, the van dying in traffic, or a no-start after the battery runs down.
issues.why: Oil leaking from the valve cover soaks the alternator and makes it fail, sometimes more than once if the leak isn't fixed first.
issues.next: If the battery light comes on, head somewhere safe; the van may only run a short time. Fix the oil leak along with the alternator, or the new one can fail too.

issues.t: Power sliding doors won't latch or open by themselves
issues.sym: A sliding door won't close all the way, stops and reverses, won't open with the button, or pops open while driving.
issues.why: The power sliding door latches, switches and controllers fail. This is one of the most common owner complaints to NHTSA for this van.
issues.next: Don't carry passengers next to a door that won't latch. Lock the doors and use child locks, and have the latch, switches and door control module checked.

issues.t: Front lower control arms can rust through and break (recall)
issues.sym: Clunking from the front end, wandering steering, or in the worst case a control arm snapping and the wheel shifting.
issues.why: Road salt corrodes the front lower control arms until they crack. Hyundai recalled these vans to inspect them and rust-proof or replace the arms. Owners still report breaks on high-mileage vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 13V556000. If you hear clunks or the steering feels loose, stop driving and have the arms inspected.

issues.t: Hood can fly open from a corroded safety latch (recall)
issues.sym: The hood rattles, won't latch firmly, or flies up at speed and blocks the windshield.
issues.why: The secondary hood latch can corrode and stick open, so if the main latch lets go nothing stops the hood. Owners report hoods flying up and cracking windshields.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 16V843000. If the hood ever seems loose, don't drive until the latch is fixed.

issues.t: ABS module can short and start a fire (recall)
issues.sym: ABS warning light, a burning smell, or smoke from the engine bay, even when the van is parked and off.
issues.why: Moisture can get into the ABS control module and short it, which can start a fire. Hyundai's fix adds a relay that cuts power to the module when the van is off.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: if you smell burning or see smoke, pull over where it's safe, turn the engine off, get everyone out and well away from the car, and call 911 if there are flames. Don't drive it again until it has been repaired. Check your VIN for recall 20V061000. Until it's done, park outside and away from buildings.

issues.t: Shifter can leave Park and brake lights may fail (recall)
issues.sym: Brake lights don't come on, cruise control won't cancel when you brake, an ESC light appears, or the shifter moves out of Park without pressing the brake.
issues.why: The brake light (stop lamp) switch can malfunction. Hyundai recalled these vans in 2013 to replace it.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 13V113000. Have someone confirm your brake lights work; the dealer replaces the switch free.

issues.t: Brake lights stay on or don't light from a faulty switch (recall)
issues.sym: Brake lights stay on after you let off the pedal or don't light at all; cruise control or the ESC light may act up.
issues.why: An earlier stop lamp switch defect led to a 2009 recall on 2007 vans.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 09V122000 as well as the later brake switch recall.

issues.t: Brake light wiring can rub on the steering shaft (recall)
issues.sym: Brake lights that work only sometimes, or no warning at all.
issues.why: On vans with adjustable pedals, the brake light switch wiring could move and rub against the steering column joint, wearing through its insulation.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 06V356000. The dealer inspects, repairs and secures the harness free.

issues.t: Engine stalls or loses power while driving
issues.sym: The van suddenly loses power or won't accelerate, sometimes with the check engine and ESC lights on, or stalls and won't restart right away.
issues.why: Owners report stalling and power loss to NHTSA; causes include alternator failure from oil leaks, wiring faults and engine sensor problems.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: turn on your hazard lights, hold the wheel firmly and steer to a safe spot off the road. Steering and brakes can feel much heavier when the engine or power cuts out, so press the brake harder than normal. Have it checked before you drive it again. Get to a safe spot and turn on your hazards. Have the codes read right away and check for the oil-soaked alternator problem.

issues.t: Driver seat mounts crack and the seat rocks
issues.sym: The driver seat rocks or feels loose, especially when braking or accelerating.
issues.why: The seat frame mounts crack, usually after about 70,000 to 115,000 miles.
issues.next: A loose driver seat is a safety risk in a crash and while driving. Have the seat frame inspected; it may need a replacement seat or frame.

issues.t: Airbag or seat belt warning light stays on
issues.sym: The airbag light or the seat belt reminder stays lit even when nothing seems wrong.
issues.why: Owners report faulty seat belt sensors and passenger seat weight sensors; one needed a whole seat assembly to fix.
issues.next: An airbag light means the airbags may not work in a crash. Have the airbag system scanned for codes soon.

issues.t: Steering wheel shimmy or vibration at highway speed
issues.sym: The steering wheel shakes or the van shimmies at highway speed; a few owners also report a loose-feeling steering wheel.
issues.why: Owners report vibration and shimmy complaints to NHTSA; worn or out-of-balance tires, warped brake rotors and worn front suspension parts are the usual places to look.
issues.next: Have the tires balanced and the front end, rotors and control arms checked, especially since these vans also have the control arm rust recall.

issues.t: Shifter won't come out of Park
issues.sym: You press the brake but the gear selector stays locked in Park.
issues.why: The shift lever and brake-shift interlock can bind or fail. A redesigned gearshift lever was released for this.
issues.next: Check that your brake lights work (a bad brake switch causes this too). Ask a dealer about the updated shift lever.

issues.t: Check engine light that needs a computer update
issues.sym: The check engine light comes on with engine-related codes but the van seems to drive normally.
issues.why: Several engine faults on this van can trigger the light, and some are corrected by reprogramming the engine computer.
issues.next: Have the codes read. Ask a dealer whether a software update applies before replacing parts.

issues.sym: The front wipers quit in the middle of use, sometimes in the rain.
issues.why: Owners report wiper failures to NHTSA; the wiper motor, linkage or wiring can be at fault.
issues.next: Pull over safely if you can't see. Have the wiper motor, linkage and fuse checked.

issues.sym: The van won't start, starts slowly, or the battery keeps dying.
issues.why: Owners report dead batteries and no-starts; a weak alternator, battery drain from door electronics and loose connections are common causes.
issues.next: Have the battery, alternator and parasitic drain tested together.

issues.t: Headlight and turn signal bulbs burn out repeatedly
issues.sym: Headlight or turn signal bulbs keep failing; the turn signal may flash fast.
issues.why: Owners report repeated bulb failures and one turn-signal fault traced to the body control module.
issues.next: Replace bulbs in pairs and have the sockets and wiring checked for heat damage if they keep failing.

issues.t: Door sensors don't detect open doors
issues.sym: The dome light or door-ajar warning doesn't come on when a door is open, or stays on when closed.
issues.why: The door switches or sensors fail on high-mileage vans.
issues.next: Have the door switches checked. A faulty door sensor can also affect the power doors and drain the battery.
